query_analysis.original_query: What are the mass transfer rate intervals for SOx in gas sweetening using sodium hydroxide ? Please provide accurate intervals.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Provide detailed and accurate ranges of mass transfer rates for sulfur oxides (SOx) during gas sweetening processes using sodium hydroxide as the scrubbing agent.

clarification_questions: What are the specific operating conditions (temperature, pressure, gas composition) of your gas sweetening process?
